summary.text: David Tarnas represents House District 8 (North and South Kohala) in the Hawaii House of Representatives, to which he was elected in 2018; he previously represented Kohala and Kona from 1994 to 1998.

paragraphs.text: Tarnas is a professional environmental planner with a firm he and his wife formed, and has served as Hawaiʻi County Chairman of the Democratic Party of Hawaiʻi.
Tarnas chairs the House Committee on Judiciary and Hawaiian Affairs for the 2025-2026 session.
